name: pc.evidence-protected-sink-profile.v1
authorityRules: Host-installed issuer key, environment and exact participant/privacy/sink scope are mandatory; a supplied public key is not trust.
The signed deadline and exact transport configuration apply before dispatch and before checkpoint commit.
Renewed profile authority may cover the original transport intent only when its exact transport digest and signer binding match; it does not authorize another PUT.
Profile admission is operational installation; no public request may install roots, profiles or receipt keys.

The immutable host grant binds the dedicated database login to one Identity workload credential and epoch; new effects require its current active credential and principal. This state check does not claim mTLS peer authentication.
This profile admits only exact encrypted RAW_SOURCE_BODY protected-proof packets from the separately authenticated source owner; it never admits ordinary segment custody or disclosure.
A fresh PUT must be admitted and dispatched before the immutable proof retain-until deadline, even when a hold exists. The provider retention timestamp must equal that deadline.

After proof expiry only the original dispatched attempt may be reconciled and an existing remote version may receive current hold updates. No deadline extension, new PUT, re-encryption, key access or resurrection is authorized.
